notes.title: Pokémon adventure — animated companions and media-friendly sound
notes.text: Sprite portraits animate throughout menus, companion panels and character creation when Animations is on. Turning it off or enabling reduced motion uses static files; forms without animation use a subtle idle with the exact static image. Button volume is configurable from 0 to 100%. Mix with other media uses Web Audio and supported ambient sessions, avoiding media playback fallback; unsupported iOS mixing stays silent rather than taking video focus. Character-owned preferences persist across chats and reloads.
